required_reconciliation: visualization counts must derive from supervisor/regression rows or declare local embedded rows
sibling synthesis must cite lane authority and any repo-inspection blocker
exception export must define row grain even when row count is zero
handoff must carry open blockers without converting them into closure claims

status_semantics.PASS_SHAPE_ONLY: local shape or guard passed without external authority
status_semantics.OPEN_GAP: known unresolved requirement or approval/scope gap
status_semantics.FAIL_BLOCKER: must not proceed through that route until resolved

strict_boundaries: no external connector write is implied by a manifest
no destructive cleanup is implied by a manifest
no GMUT gate closure is implied by a manifest
no sibling advisory has publication authority
